title: Scale By The Bay 2019: Bryan Cantrill, Was He Wright All Along? Software After Moore's Law
summary: Bryan Cantrill's Scale By The Bay 2019 talk on software after Moore's Law. He covers the end of easy scaling and the move toward specialized, emerging architectures.
why: HN recommends it as a history and analysis of the end of scaling from a well-regarded systems speaker, and lists it among the best talks of 2019.

quote.text: Bryan Cantrill has a great talk on this and the end of scaling
